name: unlockers
description: UNLOCKERS : escape game coopératif à information asymétrique (ESME)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,screen,phone -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @unlockers/server" "npm run dev -w @unlockers/screen --if-present" "npm run dev -w @unlockers/phone --if-present"
scripts.dev:mock: concurrently -n mock,screen,phone -c yellow,magenta,green "npm run mock -w @unlockers/server" "npm run dev -w @unlockers/screen --if-present" "npm run dev -w @unlockers/phone --if-present"
